findings.summary: The initial equivalence proof could authorize a base tip that moved again while the two GitHub comparisons were being read.
evidence: Verification: `git show bbed022c65cec7070c99ff1688d8cf293614bd1e:src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/LiveHandlers.fs` shows one `prBaseTipSha` observation followed by two comparisons and an immediate success result, with no post-comparison base-tip confirmation.
Verification: the exact initial test tree at bbed022c had no test containing `moved again`; `git grep -n 'moved again' bbed022c65cec7070c99ff1688d8cf293614bd1e -- tests` returns no match.
resolution_evidence: Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/LiveHandlers.fs:386-399` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c re-reads the live base after the comparisons, rejects unreadable or changed confirmation, and only then mints bound evidence.

Verification: `tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests/LandableNotOpenTests.fs:421-437` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c drives a different second base-tip response and asserts the pending refusal; exact-head Lifecycle tests passed 147/147 via `dotnet test tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests.fsproj --no-restore --nologo`.

findings.summary: The first repair made landable green across a safe base advance, but the canonical guarded-delivery merge still enforced exact base equality and therefore could not land that PR.
evidence: Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/DeliveryApplication.fs:518-524` at 45774150d2f467da292e8d3344da6b7b37f9be4c rejects every `currentBase` unequal to the accepted review base with `delivery effective base changed after acceptance`.

Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/LiveHandlers.fs:542-568` at 45774150d2f467da292e8d3344da6b7b37f9be4c sends the canonical `delivery --apply` path through that exact-base guard after `landable` has admitted the moved base.
resolution_evidence: Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/LiveHandlers.fs:343-399,585-635` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c uses the same complete forward-only/path-disjoint comparison proof at both landable and immediately before guarded merge, while re-reading claim, head, base, and repository merge policy.

Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/DeliveryApplication.fs:501-566` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c binds BaseAdvanceEvidence to accepted base, current base, and exact head; missing or mismatched evidence refuses before invoking the merge callback.

Verification: `tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests/DeliveryApplicationTests.fs:682-816` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c covers missing evidence, successful bound evidence and live-base receipt, stale claim/head, and wrong accepted/current/head evidence; exact-head Lifecycle tests passed 147/147.

verification_evidence: Verification: issue https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/3274 requires preservation only for an unchanged head with a forward-only, complete, path-disjoint base advance and explicitly retains changed-head, rewrite/divergence, overlap/conflict, incomplete comparison, and stale-authority refusals.

Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.GitHub/Reads.fs:856-907` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c parses status, merge base, and ahead count, includes both paths for renames, and marks an exactly-300-file response incomplete; GitHub's official compare-commits REST description states that changed files appear on the first page and include up to 300 files for the entire comparison (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/commits#compare-two-commits).

Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle/LiveHandlers.fs:354-399` at 6523db9d9fd7460183743697293a7ae19b39312c performs zero comparison reads when the base is unchanged, and otherwise rejects unreadable/capped evidence, non-forward topology, an unbound candidate delta, path overlap, and mid-proof base movement.

Verification: `tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests/LandableNotOpenTests.fs:332-451`, `tests/FS.GG.Coord.Cli.Lifecycle.Tests/DeliveryApplicationTests.fs:682-816`, and `tests/FS.GG.Coord.GitHub.Tests/ReadTests.fs:3131-3171` cover unchanged-base success, moved-base success, overlap, divergence, unreadable evidence, mid-proof movement, guarded-merge evidence binding, rename paths, the 300-file cap, and malformed rename evidence.
